newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda sells $1.8 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Uganda sells $1.8 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Uganda sold two billion shillings ($1.8 million) of the main 91-day treasury bills at the weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
The central bank said it sold the bills at an annualised yield of 9.859 percent, a 1.119 percent fall from last week. Sales were at an average weighted price of 97.542 from 97.308.
The Bank of Uganda invited tenders for 4.5 billion shillings of treasury bills for the next auction on Wednesday.
